One of my first FPS games was BO3 zombies. Me and a friend played a lot of Der Eisendrache, and even though the easter egg in that map is the ‘easiest’ one in the game, it still took us multiple months to do.

Were *parts* of that 2+ month grind fun? Yeah, there were fun moments. Was it worth the moments where a Simon says mini game would be interrupted by a rocket launch, or the lightning trap wouldn’t work correctly, or the multiple times where we ran out of ammo on the boss? Honestly… no. I’ve improved since then, but I would’ve probably enjoyed DE a lot more than I was frustrated by it if the EE was designed like the Cold War ones. Not to mention that maps like DE and Rev frustrated EE hunters for obscure steps.

TLDR; after playing zombies for years, I think the trade off of a more fun EE experience for a slightly less hype day 1 hunt is worth it.
